notes: Decisions are provisional until the multi-case corpus is run.
Keep means retain as a distinct semantic field.
Merge means preserve the meaning inside another event or metadata structure.
Defer means collect only after the audit or outside live selection.
Remove means do not serialize as a per-run semantic field; retain policy in schema or code when noted.
